```
def subgradient_descent(h, max_iter, init_step, target, start_time, timeout):
    step = init_step
    best_h = h.copy()
    best_c5 = evaluate_c5(h)
    for t in range(max_iter):
        if time.time() > timeout:
            break
        # compute correlation via FFT
        N = len(h)
        dx = 2.0 / N
        L = 2*N - 1
        h_rev = h[::-1]
        b = 1 - h
        corr = np.fft.ifft(np.fft.fft(h_rev, L) * np.fft.fft(b, L)).real
        # identify max shift
        idx_max = np.argmax(corr)
        shift = idx_max - (N-1)
        # gradient
        g = np.zeros_like(h)
        if shift >= 0:
            # i+shift index condition
            g[:N-shift] += 1 - h[shift:]
            g[shift:] -= h[:N-shift]
        else:
            s = -shift
            # shift negative
            g[s:] += 1 - h[:N-s]
            g[:N-s] -= h[s:]
        # update
        step = init_step / math.sqrt(t+1)
        h_new = h - step * g
        h_new = np.clip(h_new, 0, 1)
        h_new = project_sum_box(h_new, target)
        h = h_new
        cur_c5 = evaluate_c5(h)
        if cur_c5 < best_c5:
            best_c5 = cur_c5
            best_h = h.copy()
    return best_h, best_c5
```
